question: Among molecules that contain at least one sodium atom and at least one oxygen atom involved in a double bond, how many are non-carcinogenic?

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom a WHERE a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND a.XCL_003 = 'na')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON c.XCL_007 = a.XCL_001 OR c.XCL_008 = a.XCL_001
    JOIN bond b ON b.XCL_004 = c.XCL_009
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010 AND a.XCL_003 = 'o' AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  );
